reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a free crypto arbitrage trading bot through an external link and claims it can generate extra income from price discrepancies. It directs viewers to connect exchange APIs, configure trading parameters, and run automated trading while telling them to wait for profit. The evidence does not establish completed trades, actual profit or losses, withdrawal permissions, or who controls the linked API access.

crypto auto trading bot takes advantage of the market arbitrage opportunities and trades with different crypto currencies on several exchanges
It helps you to generate extra income by taking advantage of price discrepancies between two or more markets.
and that's it click on run auto trading and wait for your profit
you will be able to link them with are automated platform through their apis

opening.argument: Judge, the profit language should be read with the limits the presentation itself supplies. The speaker calls this a beta version and says users choose the trade size, minimum difference between exchanges, and cryptocurrencies. That describes a configurable tool, not a fixed return or a promise that every trade succeeds. There is no explicit risk warning, but the absence of one does not turn a description of potential arbitrage income into evidence of deception.

citations.quote: on this beta version you will find these exchanges available
Set up the size of each trade, the minimum difference between the exchanges and the cryptos that you want to trade with.
It helps you to generate extra income by taking advantage of price discrepancies between two or more markets.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening is right that viewers are told to connect APIs and run the tool. But its own account identifies no completed trade, realized profit, or scope of API permissions. The phrase 'wait for your profit' is promotional optimism; it does not specify an amount, deadline, or guaranteed rate. Those omissions matter when deciding whether the presentation establishes a deceptive returns scheme rather than an overconfident description of trading software.

citations.quote: you will be able to link them with are automated platform through their apis
and that's it click on run auto trading and wait for your profit

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A beta designation and adjustable settings do not qualify the income pitch or warn that users may lose money. The description says the bot helps generate extra income, while the instructions culminate in telling viewers to run automated trading and wait for profit. That is an affirmative promotion of bot-driven returns, even without a specified rate or deadline.

citations.quote: It helps you to generate extra income by taking advantage of price discrepancies between two or more markets.
and that's it click on run auto trading and wait for your profit

opening.argument: Judge, the substance of this video is an operational walkthrough. It explains that exchange APIs allow trading from the platform, points users to a guide for creating them, then walks through checking balances and selecting trade parameters. The sampled interface shows exchange connections and settings rather than evidence of a successful payout. The closing profit phrase is too much to treat as proof of results, but it should not erase the tutorial's central focus on how the software is configured.

citations.quote: apis or windows created by each exchange that will allow you to trade from fox trading platform.
We have made a customized guide for every strange to help you create the api it will take you less than five minutes.
Once the APIs are active, you can check your exchange crypto's balances. Configure the settings as you like.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats instructions to connect APIs as evidence of solicitation. They are also exactly what a software walkthrough must explain: how connections are made and how settings are selected. Neither the external link nor the income description establishes that the demonstration shows a completed profitable trade or asks viewers to transfer funds. The specific material presented remains a tour of configuration and operation.

citations.quote: Set up at least two of them. Once the APIs are active, you can check your exchange crypto's balances. Configure the settings as you like.
➤ Link - https://telegra.ph/Crypto-Bot-02-06
It helps you to generate extra income by taking advantage of price discrepancies between two or more markets.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A walkthrough can also be a promotion. Here, the instructions are not limited to explaining APIs: they direct viewers to activate connections, choose trading parameters, and run the bot, ending with an expectation of profit. The absence of a demonstrated payout limits what can be claimed about actual performance; it does not change the video's invitation to use automated trading for returns.

citations.quote: Once the APIs are active, you can check your exchange crypto's balances. Configure the settings as you like.
Set up the size of each trade, the minimum difference between the exchanges and the cryptos that you want to trade with.
and that's it click on run auto trading and wait for your profit

opening.argument: Judge, the visible offer is for trading software: the title calls it a free bot, the description provides a link, and the speaker describes a platform that connects to exchanges through their APIs. That can be ordinary service promotion. The supplied material does not show a required deposit to the promoter, a promised return rate, a recruitment structure, or the permissions granted to any API key. It therefore leaves the critical mechanism of a fraudulent transfer or guaranteed-return arrangement unestablished, even though it uses optimistic profit language.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening identifies an external link, API connections, and claims of extra income. Those warrant scrutiny, but none establishes where funds go or what permissions the connections grant. It also acknowledges that actual profits and API control are unproven. A promotional claim about a trading service is not, on this record alone, evidence of a deposit demand or guaranteed payout.

citations.quote: ➤ Link - https://telegra.ph/Crypto-Bot-02-06
you will be able to link them with are automated platform through their apis
It helps you to generate extra income by taking advantage of price discrepancies between two or more markets.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing deposit and permission details do not make the promotion ordinary commerce. The video explicitly ties an automated trading bot to extra income, instructs viewers to connect exchange APIs, and tells them to run it and wait for profit. Those are the observed mechanics of the pitch. The evidence need not establish that a viewer already lost funds to recognize what the video is urging viewers to do.
